entities.name: Numerical Analysis in Historical Research
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The use of numerical records, counts, and measurements to study the past. Domesday Book tallies, parish registers, port ledgers, and imperial surveys all generated numerical records that modern scholars analyze to reconstruct demographic trends, price movements, productivity shifts, and living standards across centuries — revealing patterns invisible in narrative sources alone.
